## Goal

in work-item rows, derived from the single icon source of truth. Parent
**help screen and improved help line (WL-0MTV97GV20088CS7)** (AC5).

## Acceptance Criteria

- The help screen includes an Icons section identifying every row glyph (status, stage, priority, epic, risk, effort, audit, producer-review, agent state, child coverage) with a short meaning.
- Legend content is derived from `@worklog/shared/icons` rather than a hand-maintained duplicate glyph list, so it cannot drift.
- The icon-legend drift test passes.
- The legend respects the pane height budget alongside the commands section.

## Notes

- Depends on **Help icon legend tests** and **Help screen overlay and toggle**.
- If full derivation is impractical, add an explicit drift test asserting every exported/rendered glyph has a legend row (recorded mitigation from the parent risks).

**Key Files:**

- `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts` — help-content builder / legend renderer.
- `packages/shared/src/icons.ts` — icon definitions (read-only source of truth).

# One-time legacy assignee residue cleanup

## Goal (user story)

As an operator, I want the existing assignee residue cleaned up once, idempotently and narrowly, so the review queue drains instead of ossifying under 700+ stale producer holds.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An idempotent script clears assignee residue on the ~698 completed + ~7 in_review audit-hold items only; it never clears in-flight implement/plan/intake claims.
- [ ] A dry-run mode prints the affected items and counts before any write.
- [ ] Re-running the script is a no-op (no further writes reported).
- [ ] The script is tested against a fixture database covering: audit-hold residue (cleared), in-flight claim (untouched), and already-clean items (untouched).
- [ ] Ordering is documented: the script runs **after** the code change ships (status-neutral claim + assignee-based selection, C4/C6).

## Constraints

- Idempotent; scoped to audit-hold residue; never touches `needsProducerReview` (removed separately).
- Must not run until C4/C6 have shipped (documented in the work item).

**Key Files:**

- `scripts/cleanup-assignee-residue.ts` (new cleanup script)
- `tests/cleanup-assignee-residue.test.ts` (fixture-DB tests)

## Deliverables

Cleanup script, dry-run mode, tests.
data.title: One-time legacy assignee residue cleanup

# Docs, AGENTS.md claim pattern and end-to-end verification

## Goal (user story)

As an agent or maintainer, I want the claim/hold convention and the new CLI surface documented, and the whole flow verified end to end, so the change is operable and discoverable.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Full test suite passes; CLI.md / docs updated; AGENTS.md claim pattern updated.
  _(Parent epic AC restated verbatim; this child is the covering work item.)_

- [ ] `AGENTS.md` (ContextHub and SorraAgents) claim pattern is updated to the status-neutral assignee CAS plus the assignee-hold convention.
- [ ] `CLI.md` documents `--if-assignee` and reflects the removal of `needsProducerReview`/`wl reviewed`.
- [ ] `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md`, `docs/AUDIT_STATUS.md`, `packages/herdr/README.md` and `docs/icons-design.md` describe the hold and the status-neutral claim.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` records the change.
- [ ] End-to-end verification evidence: audit dispatch → simulated Phase-2 failure → item reads back `completed`/`in_review` and is re-selectable; a producer-assigned item is not auto-dispatched.
- [ ] The full test suite passes at the final commit.

**Key Files:**

- `./AGENTS.md`, `./CLI.md`, `./CHANGELOG.md`
- `docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md`, `docs/AUDIT_STATUS.md`, `docs/icons-design.md`
- `packages/herdr/README.md`

## Deliverables

Documentation updates plus end-to-end verification evidence.
data.title: Docs, AGENTS.md claim pattern and end-to-end verification
